text:
sam_sales: Heads-up — Acme Legal just sent back a pre-sales checklist. They want SIG/CAIQ + DPA with SCCs, proof of EU data residency, and a clear DSAR/data deletion workflow. Main blocker: they need user content deletions within 30 days and logs retained in EU-only storage.

jordan_sec: thanks. couple clarifying q's — are they asking for EU processing only (no egress), or do they accept encrypted export if keys stay in EU? also need to confirm which logs: access logs vs. raw request bodies.

alice_acme: correct — no egress of PII. We can allow encrypted backups if you hold keys in an EU KMS or use customer-managed keys. They also require audit trails for 3 years for billing/audit, but user-requested content (message text, uploads) must be deletable within 30 days.

maya_legal: from legal side, we can offer our standard DPA but need to add a clause mapping SCC modules. I can draft a narrow data processing schedule for EU-only processing + CMK language. Also recommend clarifying subprocessors list and notification SLA for security incidents (48h).

leo_se: implementation notes: Redwood supports Private deployment (VPC) and customer-managed KMS/HSM — that handles key residency. For hosted route we can offer region pinning to eu-west with zero-replication outside region for customer data. We also have a data deletion API:
```bash
DELETE /v1/customers/{customer_id}/data?scope=user_content
```
It kicks a background job to scrub KV cache, embeddings index, and object store references; audit event emitted.

tara_infra: logging details: we separate structured telemetry (metrics/traces) from request logs. Request bodies that contain PII are stored encrypted at rest and can be purged by trace id. Retention policy is configurable per-tenant; default access-log retention = 180 days. For EU-only requirement we can spin a region-isolated log-bucket and apply lifecycle rules. Need approval for retention <-> audit tradeoff.

sam_sales: can we surface the artifacts Acme asked for in one bundle? They want CAIQ, SOC2 Type II, pen test summary (redacted), DPA + SCC mapping, and a short runbook for DSARs/deletions they can hand to their auditors.

jordan_sec: I can export a CAIQ and a summarized control mapping for the items they flagged (data residency, KM, deletion, incident response). SOC2 + pen test are available as redacted PDFs. I’ll add a short DSAR runbook that shows API calls, expected latencies, and audit events.

maya_legal: draft DPA language i propose: "customer data shall be processed in the EU; subprocessors shall be listed and consented; customer retains ownership of keys when CMK enabled; deletion requests will be executed within 30 days unless law requires retention." I'll attach soft language for SCC module choices (Module 2 + Addendum as applicable).

alice_acme: that sounds good. One more operational ask: during the POC we need a sandbox with anonymized production-like data and the ability to trigger DSAR flows so our compliance team can validate. Can we schedule that?

leo_se: yes — propose a 2-week POC: week 1 deploy sandbox in eu-central, week 2 run DSAR scenarios + retention tests. We'll provide a checklist and sample dataset sanitizer script.

sam_sales: putting together calendar invites. Jordan - can you assemble the artifact bundle by EOD tomorrow? Maya - we'll need the DPA draft for internal legal review by then as well.

jordan_sec: on it, sending CAIQ + control mapping by 18:00 CET. :thumbsup:

maya_legal: will circulate DPA draft and SCC notes by EOD. :white_check_mark:

deploybot: [deploy] created ephemeral sandbox: infra-id rwd-sandbox-72 in eu-central, expires in 14 days.

tara_infra: note — for the sandbox I will enable CMK with policy restricting export. Also setting log-buckets to EU-only. Will document retention toggles.

alice_acme: great, thanks team. We'll have our compliance lead join the kickoff tomorrow.

sam_sales: thanks everyone — I'll post the invite and include the artifact list. Follow-ups in-thread or ping me directly. :wave:
